query: SELECT u.id, u.name, cp.id as profile_id FROM users u JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.userId = u.id WHERE u.name LIKE '%Amanda%' OR u.name LIKE '%Lord%' OR u.email LIKE '%amanda%' LIMIT 5;
